items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the delivery envelope copy on page 2 states 'zugestellt am 21.05.2026', so service occurred on Thu 21 May 2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so counting starts Fri 22 May 2026. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, § 43 StPO via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) later is Thu 4 Jun 2026. That day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in Bayern, so under § 43 StPO the deadline moves to the next working day, Fri 5 Jun 2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the decision is final
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks 'ab Rechtskraft' (from legal finality). Under § 84 OWiG the Bußgeldbescheid becomes rechtskräftig when the two-week Einspruch period expires without an objection being filed, i.e. at the end of Fri 5 Jun 2026 (see the objection deadline above). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day itself is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts Sat 6 Jun 2026 and runs, under § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, to Fri 19 Jun 2026, which is a normal working day so no shift is needed. This assumes no Einspruch is filed; if one is filed in time, Rechtskraft (and so this payment deadline) does not occur on this date and the fine is not yet enforceable.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-06-19) assumes the fine becomes final because no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 2026-06-05; if an Einspruch is filed in time, the fine is not yet enforceable and this payment date does not apply.

The IBAN given for payment (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, Sparkasse Musterau) checks out structurally and matches the named bank, but as with any payment instruction it is worth confirming it against a second official source (e.g. the city's website) before transferring money.
